findings.claim: The internal gate denies write-only case callers even though the write routes themselves require only `case_write`.
findings.evidence: The case policy first accepts `CaseResource { write: true }` with `required = "case_write"`, but then unconditionally calls `state.services.read_case(&context, &capabilities, case_id)`, and `AppServices::read_case` in `crates/aso-host/src/case_management.rs` requires `"case:read"`; acceptance requires refusal only when the caller lacks the capability required by this operation.
findings.suggested_fix: For write case resources, validate case existence/scope through a repository/service path that requires `case_write`, or add a dedicated `require_case_access(context, capabilities, case_id, required_capability)` check instead of calling the read endpoint.
